events.content: On another subject, which country did her brother Ansel emigrate to?
I do not know.
Random question, but what kind of car did she drive?
I do not know.
What was her favourite opening?
I do not know.
Something I've always wondered. What colour was the coat Edmund lent her the day they met?

arguments.query: color of coat Edmund lent Tessaly

events.content: I don't know what colour the coat was.
Who made the wedding dress?
Her mother, Edrith, was a seamstress who sewed wedding dresses in the summer.
What year was he born?
I do not know.
Which city did she stay in?
I do not know.
So what was her actual first word?
I do not know.
By the way, which university did Mum study at?
I do not know.
Different question. What was the name of the school she went to?
I do not know.
So far they've only let me sweep and sand. Six weeks of sanding.
Tessaly said she learned patience from watching her mother unpick a seam without complaint.
They're saying the lower town might flood if the surge comes in with the tide.
I remember when a storm surge flooded the lower town in January 1953. Tessaly was only eleven then.
He entered his honey in the county show this year and came nowhere, poor man.
Oh, I don't know about that. I only know about Tessaly's lovely speciality in marbled endpapers.
Dad's going into hospital next week for a new hip, and he's dreading the boredom.
Oh, your father's going to be okay. Tessaly had a hip replacement herself back in 2015.
At least I got some knitting done on the way. I'm attempting my first jumper.
Tessaly used to knit one fisherman's jumper each winter, always in undyed wool. She never followed a pattern and never made two alike.
Anyway, I'm in a panic. We fly on Friday and I can't find my passport anywhere.
Oh dear, that sounds stressful. I recall Tessaly once lost her passport in Port Saverne in 1983.
One nice thing, though. I've signed up for piano lessons, and the first one is on Monday.
That's wonderful news! You know, Tessaly once bought a second-hand upright piano at fifty-five and took four lessons.
We haven't spoken in weeks, and I keep going to bed angry about it.
Tessaly's advice on quarrels was never to go to bed on an argument you can end with a cup of tea.
This Saturday I'm trying something with saffron for the first time.
Tessaly's saffron buns were made with a pinch of cardamom and soaked currants and baked on Saturdays. That recipe came from her grandmother Hester.
My friends want me to do a New Year's Day sea swim with them. I think they're mad.
I do not know.
Did he ever make a clock for her?
For their twenty-fifth anniversary, Edmund built her a ship's clock in a walnut case. He even set it four minutes fast so she would never miss the ferry.
Did anyone work there with her?

arguments.query: people who worked at bookbinding shop

events.content: Yes, she trained one apprentice named Corwin Hale. He started by sweeping the shop floor at sixteen.
What was the biggest job she ever took on?
I do not know.
Wasn't there a cat?
Yes, her last companion was a grey cat named Vellum, who slept in the paper drawer. Vellum came from the lifeboat station, where she had been living under the slipway.
Did her honey ever win anything?
Her heather honey actually won second prize at the Dunmere fair in 1991. She maintained that the winner had added sugar.
Where did they go afterwards, for the honeymoon?
For their honeymoon, they took the night train to Vessant and stayed for five days.
Did he ever hurt himself as a child?
I remember in the summer of 1977, Jory fell from the pear tree and broke his left arm. Tessaly covered the plaster cast in blue book cloth so he would stop picking at it.
Did they have any pets out there?
Yes, the family dog was a wire-haired terrier called Pilchard. He was fond of riding in the bow of your great-grandfather's skiff.
Did she ever travel anywhere to study it?
In 1998, she traveled to Japan for three weeks to study suminagashi, floating-ink marbling, with a teacher named Hayato Mori.
Was there anything she regretted?
I do not know.
Oh, and where did her cat Vellum come from originally?
Vellum was a grey cat that came from the lifeboat station, where she had been living under the slipway.
Completely different question: what was the name of the dog she had as a child?

arguments.query: dog name when Tessaly was a child

events.content: I do not know.
By the way, what was Uncle Jory's first word?
Jory's first word was "boat".
Different topic: what year did she have her hip replaced?
She had her hip replacement in 2015.
On another note, did her honey ever win a prize at a fair?
Yes, her heather honey won second prize at the Dunmere fair in 1991. She maintained that the winner had added sugar.
Something else I've wondered: how many steps were there up the lighthouse at Carrow Point?
I do not know.
Changing the subject, what was her bindery called?
She opened her own bindery, The Gilded Signature, on Tanner's Row in 1974.
Unrelated, but who was the teacher she studied with in Japan?
She studied suminagashi with a teacher named Hayato Mori when she traveled to Japan in 1998.
Before I forget, what was the tune Grandpa Edmund loved? We want to play it at the reunion.
Edmund's favourite tune was The Larkspur Waltz. He even whistled it while working.
That reminds me, I need it for the family tree: what date did she and Edmund get married?
Tessaly and Edmund married on 14 May 1964 at St Brannoc chapel.
